sentences.en: The sun is bright in the sky.
The moon comes out at night.
I see a star in the dark sky.
sentences.zh: 我在黑暗的天空中看到一颗星星。

sentences.en: The sky is blue and clear today.
A white cloud is in the sky.
The rain falls on the earth.
The wind is strong today.
Snow is white and cold.
The ice on the road is dangerous.
The earth is round.
We walk up the hill.
The river goes to the sea.
The rock is very hard.
The sun gives light and heat to the earth.
sentences.zh: 太阳给地球带来光和热。

sentences.en: The island in the sea has a rocky shore.
sentences.zh: 海中的岛屿有一个岩石海岸。

sentences.en: The cave in the mountain was dark.
A valley is the low land between hills.
sentences.zh: 山谷是山丘之间的低地。

sentences.en: The stone on the beach was smooth.
The grain of sand is very small.
A wave came from the sea.
Life on the island was surprising.
The expansion of the town was slow.
The sound of a wing made the bird fly away.
sentences.zh: 翅膀的声音让鸟飞走了。
